concerns.text: The specification FR‑001 requires a concrete implementation of a `DynamicShiftEnvironment` wrapper that injects the shift logic. No task creates or validates this wrapper; only discovery and static‑agent tasks are present. Add a task (e.g., T022 [P] [US1]) that implements the wrapper and registers it with the EvoPolicyGym registry.

FR‑001 also mandates that the dynamic‑shift configuration be validated against its contract (`contracts/dynamic_shift_env.schema.yaml`). No task performs this validation. Add a task (e.g., T023 [P] [US1]) that loads the generated config and runs `jsonschema.validate` against the schema.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – Statistical analysis & result aggregation (FR‑005 / SC‑001)
concerns.text: SC‑001 expects the raw performance difference (e.g., mean Δ score) between baseline and counterfactual groups to be recorded. Tasks T015/T016 only output p‑value, effect size, and significance flag. Add a task (e.g., T024 [P] [US3]) that computes and stores the mean performance delta in `data/aggregation_stats.json` or a dedicated CSV.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Environment discovery & dynamic‑shift validation (edge case)
concerns.text: The spec’s edge‑case requirement to log a warning when the dynamic‑shift performance drop is not statistically significant (p ≥ 0.05) is not covered by any task. Add a task (e.g., T025 [P] [US1]) that checks `data/sensitivity_report.csv` for non‑significant rows and writes a warning to `data/shift_warnings.log`.

FR‑006 requires that the scalar‑reward fallback be integrated into the evolutionary harness so runs can continue without crashing. While T007 defines the fallback, there is no task that wires this fallback into the harness or records its use in the evolution results. Add a task (e.g., T026 [P] [US3]) that modifies `evolutionary_harness.py` to consume the scalar‑reward fallback and logs it in `data/evolution_results.csv`.
